_comment: Tavern rumours (RumorManager.gd). Up to max_active at once, each lasting days_valid days. elite: the first regular wave on that floor of that location has the named Elite; beating it banks the bonus. cache: clearing that floor's boss banks the bonus. Bonus = gold_base x the gold curve (loot/gold.json), material_rolls, gear_chance.

elite.text: Folk whisper of a {affix} beast prowling floor {floor} of {location}. They say it guards a fortune.

cache.text: A dying adventurer spoke of a cache hidden past the guardian of floor {floor} in {location}.
